verdict.line: You win if you dodge his stacking with short trades and punish every missed W (Path Maker); you lose if you facetank two Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks and eat the shockwave pull into a landed stun.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's damage is built on landing abilities, not autos — his Q (Ntofo Strikes) has to stack twice for a pull and his W (Path Maker) has to land a stun for him to get value, while your E (Counter Strike) only dodges basic attacks, not those abilities. The matchup is decided by whether he lands his low-uptime cooldowns before your R (Relentless Assault) ramps attack speed in an extended fight.

theirWindow.what: He follows a landed stun with full combo damage while his passive mark is active. Flash or Q (Leap Strike) away immediately rather than trading through it — you cannot dodge this with E since it's not a basic attack.

yourWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) whiffs or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s — after a miss he has no stun for that window. Walk in, land Q (Leap Strike) with W (Empower) up, and force a fight where he can't reset the trade.

start.why: blunts his Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke and the passive-mark autos he uses to chip you before 6

boots.why: he's an all-physical fighter leaning on autos and Q strikes, flat armor cuts his sustained damage

core.why: the AD/AS/on-hit stats convert directly into R (Relentless Assault) damage once you're in an extended fight
current-health damage and the slow help you stick to him through Q (Ntofo Strikes) slows
sustains you through his poke phase and the mark-triggered auto damage in all-ins

situational.when: he's snowballed and threatening to all-in with R (All Out) off cooldown
you're ahead and want to force uneven all-ins without death risk
you're getting burst down before your R attack-speed ramp matters

runes.keystoneWhy: rewards the exact style this lane wants — short, repeated trades and sticking through extended fights once R is up

summoners.why: Flash covers you when his W (Path Maker) stun lands since E can't dodge it; Teleport lets you play the wave-management side game his low mid-lane pressure invites

playing.title: Trade only after his Q resets
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s cooldown poke tool — don't extend trades into a second Q hit, back off and reset.

playing.title: Save E for the auto-reset, not the engage
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, so hold it for when he's already committed and swinging, not as a preemptive block against his abilities.

playing.title: Never eat a second Q stack
playing.detail: Two stacks of Ntofo Strikes fires a shockwave that pulls you in — sidestep the line rather than walking through it twice.

playing.title: Punish every missed W
playing.detail: Path Maker is his only hard stun and it's 14-10s on cooldown — if he whiffs it, immediately close with Q (Leap Strike) and empowered auto.

playing.title: Keep trades short before level 6
playing.detail: Without R your attack speed doesn't ramp, so you lose extended fights on raw stats — hit and disengage.

playing.title: All-in once R is up
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown, so the longer the fight goes past level 6, the more it favors you — commit rather than poke.

playing.title: Respect walls after his level 6
playing.detail: All Out knocks you through terrain and transforms his kit — don't fight near walls when his R is available.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names are from the standard on-hit/bruiser Jax build I know — confirm current names and any reworked mythic-slot equivalents for patch 16.18.1 before finalizing the build.
